title: Nvidia board member Stephen Neal could play big role in probe of CEO Jensen Huang
summary: Stephen Neal, a prominent figure on Nvidia's board of directors, is poised to play a significant role in the investigation concerning CEO Jensen Huang. As the lead independent director, Neal's experience and past associations, including his work with Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, may provide critical insights into the ongoing scrutiny of Huang's leadership. The implications of this investigation could have far-reaching effects on Nvidia's corporate governance and public perception.
